text: The NIIP employs a strategic portfolio approach, moving away from fragmented single-asset insurance to create better risk diversification and premium efficiency. The pilot's premium was financed using excess payout from a catastrophe bond, demonstrating a sophisticated, layered risk financing strategy. The program also features formalized claims-to-budget channels to reduce disbursement lags and improve reconstruction timelines. Additionally, the development of a web-based national asset registry strengthens exposure data and supports scalable expansion.
